company.name: Explo
company.shortDescription: Explo operates a data exploration and analysis platform to connect directly to database or warehouse sources.
company.description:
Explo operates a data exploration and analysis platform to connect directly to database or warehouse sources. It allows users to explore, analyze, and visualize data with a point-and-click interface. Explo integrates any data source, analyzes data without SQL, and shares insights and visualizations.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
